lock.authorization: Four delivered final checkpoints, fixed-state ON/OFF; existing val only; no training or retuning
lock.OFF: S=0; keep encoder, bank, local memory, R, pairs, RHS, M, seed/order, dtype and batch fixed
lock.ON: Saved float32 head; float64 reconstruction <=1e-8 and exact saved cast; must reproduce published final per-class recall and accuracy
lock.report_direction: ON minus OFF; positive BA/recall/Acc/F1 favorable; corrections and harms both retained
lock.grouping: old is all preceding tasks; new is final task; original labels and paired denominators unchanged
lock.causal_scope: Final-state local counterfactual only; OFF is not historical base/local_transport and does not undo training effects
unavailable: raw pre-dedup risk and fitted map
counterfactual history and forgetting/average incremental metrics
lock.publication: Anonymous aggregate scalars/counts only; no images, weights, features, scores, sample IDs, matrices or private paths
